verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a stablecoin infrastructure company, but the evidence pack documents no branded or white-label stablecoin issuance product. Circle Mint only lets qualified businesses mint and redeem Circle's own USDC. CCTP moves already-registered third-party assets across chains. CPN's 'self-managed' mode covers running payment flows, not issuing a new token with its own minting, redemption and reserve management. No gating terms for a branded-issuance offering are quoted.
